DK28.4 is a medical diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastrointestinal ulcer with bleeding. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases, specifically the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), this code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment complications. 

It is utilized as part of a comprehensive set of ICD-10 codes to define the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1] [^src3]. Because patients with atrial fibrillation are typically prescribed anticoagulant medications, monitoring severe bleeding events is a vital quality indicator for their care. 

The clinical indicators defined by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut rely on a broad spectrum of diagnostic codes to capture all relevant bleeding events. For gastrointestinal bleeding specifically, the criteria span from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], encompassing DK28.4 alongside related codes such as [[dk28-0|DK28.0]], [[dk28-2|DK28.2]], and [[dk28-6|DK28.6]] [^src1]. Other categories in this severe bleeding indicator include intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. 

The consistent inclusion of DK28.4 across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 AFDK annual reports underscores its established role in the methodological framework for national cardiovascular quality measurement [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
